concerns.title: Spawn-time wire NOT applied to sprint-spawner.ts
concerns.detail: The actual TASK_ASSIGN emit site lives in src/orchestra/sprint-spawner.ts line 272-288. That file is NOT in the C0c YAZMA authority list (file authority matrix strict). Per the brief, sprint-controller.ts is the wire location — so readTaskJsonFresh() and consultCollisionDecision() are exported from sprint-controller.ts as utility functions, available for the spawn pipeline to import. A follow-up task (or operator override) is required to wire them in: replace 'task' object reference in sprint-spawner.ts:280-287 TASK_ASSIGN payload with readTaskJsonFresh(projectRoot, task.id), and call consultCollisionDecision() before the writeEvent(...TASK_ASSIGN...) on collision-detected tasks. The plan-time tests validate the helpers' behavior in isolation, but the live cascade root closure is not end-to-end verified in this commit.
concerns.recommendation: Sprint 168.5 (or a sprint-spawner.ts-authored follow-up task) wires the two helpers into sprint-spawner.ts spawnWorkers() before TASK_ASSIGN emit. Add integration test that mutates task.json between PLAN and SPAWN and asserts the TASK_ASSIGN payload reflects the patch.
